Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 10

Imentesh

Creature 10 Largemonitorprotean

Perception +19 entropy sense (imprecise) 60 feet; darkvision

Languages Chthonian, Empyrean, Protean; Truespeech

Skills Acrobatics +17, Athletics +19, Deception +21, Diplomacy +19, Performance +21, Stealth +21, Thievery +17

Str +7, Dex +5, Con +5, Int +7, Wis +3, Cha +5

Entropy Sense (divine, prediction) An imentesh can anticipate the most likely location of a creature through their supernatural insight into the forces of chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants the imentesh the ability to sense creatures within the listed range. A creature under the effects of Veil of Privacy or that is otherwise shielded from divination and prediction cannot be noticed via entropy sense.

Constant Spells These spells are always active; if one is countered, it comes back next round.

AC 30; Fort +21, Ref +19, Will +17; +1 status to all saves vs. magic

HP 175, fast healing 5; Resistances precision 10, protean anatomy 15

Fast Healing 5 Regains this many Hit Points at the start of each of its turns.

Protean Anatomy 15 (divine, polymorph) An imentesh's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the imentesh takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, it gains the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case its resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The imentesh is immune to polymorph effects unless it is a willing target. If Blinded or Deafened, the imentesh automatically recovers at the end of its next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.

Effect: Protean Anatomy

Speed 25 feet, fly 25 feet, swim 25 feet, unfettered movement

Melee ◆ jaws +23 [+18/+13] (magical, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d10+11 piercing plus Warpwave Strike

Melee ◆ claw +23 [+19/+15] (agile, magical, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d6+11 slashing

Melee ◆ tail +23 [+18/+13] (magical, reach 15 feet), Damage 2d10+11 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit plus Grab

Divine Innate Spells DC 29, attack +21; 5th sending, truespeech (constant), translocate, crisis of faith, dispel magic; 4th creation, translocate (at will), unfettered movement (constant), shatter; 3rd haste, shrink item, slow, mending

Change Shape ◆ (concentrate, divine, polymorph) The imentesh takes the appearance of any Large or smaller creature. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but might change the damage type its Strikes deal.

Takes another form (polymorph); its Strikes and senses change with it.

Constrict ◆ 1d10+11 bludgeoning damage, DC 29 basic Fortitude

Deals the listed damage to every creature it has grabbed or restrained (basic Fortitude save).

Inflict Warpwave ◆ (divine) An imentesh inflicts a warpwave on a creature within 100 feet (DC 29 Fortitude save to resist).

Sneak Attack An imentesh's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard targets.

Warpwave Strike (divine) Any creature struck and damaged by an imentesh's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 29 Fortitude save or be subject to a warpwave.

Warpwaves Many proteans can subject their foes to disorienting alterations perceived in time and space by creating ripples of unstable reality in the environment called warpwaves.

When a creature fails its saving throw and is affected by a warpwave, roll 1d8 and consult the table below for the specific effect on that creature.

Unless indicated otherwise, a warpwave effect lasts for 1d4 rounds, and a new warpwave effect negates any previous warpwave effect already affecting a creature.

d8

Warpwave Effect

Clumsy 2 (Clumsy 3 on a critical failure)

Grab ◆ After a hit, it grabs the target for free (the target is grabbed until it Escapes).
